systems.country_label: Etat Civil: a platform used to identify in real time pupils without a civil-status document, filled in by school directors

note: An education programme document; its passages give only the fall in pupils without a birth certificate (826,023 in 2017 to 497,335 in 2022) and an education-ministry platform listing such pupils, which is not a civil registration system and fits none of the typology's classes.
